tp.bot.nopython: Could not start python. Check that it is on PATH.
tp.clone.notempty: {0} already exists and is not empty.
tp.clone.pickfolder: Pick a folder to clone into.
tp.deps.missing: Dependencies are missing, so the bot cannot start
tp.deps.present: aiogram, apscheduler and python-dotenv are importable
tp.description: Browse the posting bot's groups and queues, preview what goes out next, edit group settings, and run the bot.
tp.detail.nopages: No postable pages found in this archive.
tp.dialog.cloneinto: Choose where to clone the bot into
tp.error.nobot: Could not find the bot. Pick the telegram-posting-bot folder.
tp.group.name: Name
tp.group.useinterval: Post on an interval instead of a daily time
tp.groups.broken: {0} group(s) will stop the bot from starting: {1}
tp.groups.schedule.tip: Include this group in the bot's schedule
tp.issue.badfolder: Folder contains characters that are not valid in a path.
tp.issue.chatidclash: Same chat ID as '{0}'. The bot keys its schedule by chat ID, so only the last of them is scheduled and the other never posts.
tp.issue.chatidpositive: Chat ID is positive, which is a private chat. Groups and channels are negative.
tp.issue.chatidshape: Chat ID is neither a number nor an @channelname. Groups look like -1001234567890.
tp.issue.folderclash: Shares its folder with '{0}'. Whichever group posts first moves the file out of the queue.
tp.issue.foldermissing: Folder does not exist yet. The bot will create it empty at startup: {0}
tp.issue.nochatid: No chat ID yet. Forward a message from the group to @userinfobot to get it.
tp.issue.nocontent: Nothing in To_Send or Already_Sent, so this group has nothing to post.
tp.issue.nofolder: No folder yet. Set something like groups/my_group, relative to the bot root.
tp.issue.noname: No name set. The bot reads this key directly and will not start without it.
tp.issue.notosend: Folder exists but has no To_Send subfolder yet. The bot creates it at startup.
tp.issue.placeholder: Chat ID is still a placeholder. Forward a message from the group to @userinfobot to get the real one.
tp.next.interval: every {0} min from the bot's start
tp.nextup.disabled: This group is disabled, so the bot skips it entirely. The queue is what it would send once re-enabled.
tp.nextup.fallback: To_Send is empty. The bot will re-post a random file from Already_Sent and leave it there.
tp.nextup.random: post_order is random, so the bot draws its file at post time. Nothing to preview.
tp.nextup.together: {0} file(s) go out together on the next run.
tp.nopreview: No inline preview for this type
tp.saved: Saved config.json. Restart the bot for it to take effect
tp.setup.clonefailed: git clone failed (exit {0}). See the log for details. If the repository is private, make sure your credentials are already set up for it.
tp.setup.credentials: A private repository uses your existing git credentials. Meows never sees them, and the interactive prompt is disabled so a missing credential fails instead of hanging.
tp.setup.gitfailed: Could not run git: {0}. Is git installed and on PATH?
tp.setup.haveclone: Already have a clone? Use the Bot folder… button in the header instead.
tp.setup.interpreter: Installs with the interpreter shown above. If you keep the bot in a virtualenv, activate it and install there instead.
tp.setup.intro: Meows drives an existing telegram-posting-bot checkout; it does not contain one. Point it at a clone, or make one here.
tp.setup.needurl: Enter the repository URL to clone from.
tp.setup.pipfailed: pip install failed (exit {0}). See the log.
tp.setup.pythonfailed: Could not run python: {0}. Is Python installed and on PATH?
tp.setup.title: Set up the posting bot
tp.setup.tokennote: Written to .env, which is gitignored and never arrives with a clone. Meows only ever reports whether a token exists, never its value.
tp.token.missing: No BOT_TOKEN in .env, so the bot will refuse to start
tp.token.placeholder: No BOT_TOKEN in .env. Paste it here to write one
tp.tools.warn.git: git was not found on PATH, so the plugin cannot clone the bot for you.
tp.tools.warn.python: Python was not found on PATH, so the bot cannot be started or have its dependencies installed. Install it from python.org and tick "Add python.exe to PATH".
